name: jakedahn-ambition
description: The ambition plugin: /ambition turns a task into the version a more ambitious person would have asked for.

plugins.name: ambition
plugins.description: Raise the ambition of a task along three axes (altitude, depth, range) and get back one short block you can paste: the goal beyond the goal, the rewritten ask, what changed, what it needs, and the next rung.
